import rcb_dtb

def rotvec(R):
    c=np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)/2,-1,1); th=np.arccos(c)
    if th<1e-8:return np.zeros(3)
    v=np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2],R[0,2]-R[2,0],R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
    if np.pi-th<1e-5:
        eig=np.linalg.eig((R+np.eye(3))/2); return th*np.real(eig[1][:,np.argmax(np.real(eig[0]))])
    return th/(2*np.sin(th))*v

def ik(s,pos,R,nit=80):
    m,d=s.model,s.data; b=m.body('palmworld').id; qadr=s._jq[:7]; dadr=s._jv[:7]
    orig=d.qpos.copy(); q=orig[qadr].copy(); jacp=np.zeros((3,m.nv)); jacr=np.zeros((3,m.nv))
    for i in range(nit):
        d.qpos[qadr]=q; s.mj.mj_forward(m,d)
        ep=pos-d.xpos[b]; er=rotvec(R@d.xmat[b].reshape(3,3).T)
        e=np.r_[ep,er]
        if np.linalg.norm(ep)<1e-4 and np.linalg.norm(er)<1e-3: break
        s.mj.mj_jacBody(m,d,jacp,jacr,b); J=np.vstack([jacp[:,dadr],jacr[:,dadr]])
        dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.diag([1e-5]*3+[1e-4]*3),e)
        # avoid wild nullspace/hypervelocity
